stem: An insect population after x months can be modeled by the function g(x) = 18(1.3)^x. Which statement is the best interpretation of one of the values in this function?

options.label: F
options.text: The insect population increased by 13 insects each month.

options.label: G
options.text: The insect population decreased by 13 insects each month.

options.label: H
options.text: The insect population increased at a rate of 30% each month.

options.label: J
options.text: The insect population decreased at a rate of 30% each month.
